surviving.objection: ALG constant collision when jose_jws.py and jose_hpke.py are concatenated into one file; also b64u_encode/b64u_decode, InvalidSignature, and the two __all__ lists collide.
surviving.resolution: Rename jose_jws ALG->ES256_ALG and jose_hpke ALG->HPKE0_ALG, de-collide b64u_encode/b64u_decode/InvalidSignature and the two __all__ lists before merging; rewrite every reference including the 3 external call-sites that read jose_hpke.ALG (eareat_hpke.py:103, cose_hpke_verifier.py:158, eareat_hpke_verifier.py:125). demo() asserts both crypto paths work.

surviving.objection: No ordering/rollback strategy; single-pass big-bang diff leaves no importable checkpoint if something breaks mid-way.
surviving.resolution: Stage as revertable commits so the tree is importable at every commit: (1) create eat_ear/{cwt_jwt,cwt_jwt_utils}.py alongside old files, full suite green, commit; (2) flip every importer + docs to the new path, green, commit; (3) delete the 6 old files + jwt_cwt_objects2.py, update ruff.toml, green, commit. The semantic registry+EATClaimsSet work is a separate 4th commit.

surviving.objection: libattest.ear is documented public API; hard move without doc refresh breaks documented usage silently.
surviving.resolution: Hard move + doc refresh (no shim): update README.md:18, pyproject.toml:22 comment, prototypes/tpm_key_binding/README.md:29-30 to the new import path, and extend the verification grep to scan README/pyproject/docs.

surviving.objection: Plan conflates pure mechanical hard-move of existing code with new semantic work (ClaimDef registry, EATClaimsSet), making the diff unreviewable as one unit.
surviving.resolution: Split the pure mechanical hard-move (commits 1-3, relocate the BETTER existing code verbatim, with only the mandatory ALG de-collision) from the semantic registry/EATClaimsSet work (commit 4, separately reviewable). EATClaimsSet is kept per human decision 1, just in its own commit.

surviving.objection: oemid forced to bytes-only and a blanket 8-64 byte bound on generic byte-claims is over-fit and rejects valid claim values.
surviving.resolution: Per human decision 1: oemid=Union[int, Base64UrlBytes]; do not apply the 8-64 byte bound to the generic byte-claim path.

surviving.objection: eat_nonce typed as single EATNonce (spec allows list) and to_cwt_claims() re-implements JWT->CWT mapping instead of reusing existing conversion semantics.
surviving.resolution: Per human decision 1: eat_nonce=Union[EATNonce, list[EATNonce]]; to_cwt_claims() routes through jwt_style_view_to_cwt_claim_set semantics (jti_is_jwt_text=False).

surviving.objection: from_cwt() decodes unverified CWT bytes into a typed 'trusted-looking' object with no signature verification.
surviving.resolution: from_cwt() is dropped (or gated behind a required COSE verify key) — never decode unverified bytes into a typed 'trusted' object.

surviving.objection: Plan describes eareat_hpke.py attribute-access rewrite as one edit; actual bare jose_hpke./jose_jws./cwt_utils./cose_hpke. attribute-access sites number roughly 25 across multiple production files.
surviving.resolution: Enumerate every bare jose_hpke./jose_jws./cwt_utils./cose_hpke. attribute site across src/tests/prototypes with per-file counts (eareat_hpke_verifier.py ~9, cose_hpke_verifier.py ~6, cose_hpke.py's cwt_utils.jwt_to_cwt_claims, eareat_hpke.py) and list them all in the importer/rewrite section.

surviving.objection: The original grep pattern only matches dotted-module-path imports and is blind to `from libattest.formats import jose_hpke, jose_jws` style imports and bare attribute calls.
surviving.resolution: Replace the verification grep with a bare-name scan (\bjose_hpke\b|\bjose_jws\b|\bcwt_utils\b|\bcose_hpke\b|\bcwt_jwt\b) outside eat_ear/, plus a `from libattest\.formats import` scan; state pytest-green is necessary-not-sufficient.

surviving.objection: Silent wire-format rename from boot_seed to canonical RFC name bootseed could break existing callers without warning.
surviving.resolution: Accept BOTH boot_seed and bootseed as input aliases for one release in jwt_claims_to_cwt_claim_set; assert label 268 name in demo(); add to Risks. Lands in the semantic commit 4.

surviving.objection: ruff.toml still references the old src/libattest/formats/cwt_utils.py path after the file moves.
surviving.resolution: Update ruff.toml per-file-ignores path from src/libattest/formats/cwt_utils.py to src/libattest/formats/eat_ear/cwt_jwt_utils.py in the commit that moves the prints; make lint a mandatory verification step.

surviving.objection: Flat-exporting unverified inspectors (parse_ear_verdict, cose_cwt_to_jwt_view) at the top-level package invites accidental use of unverified-decode paths as if they were trusted.
surviving.resolution: Do not flat-export the unverified inspectors from eat_ear/__init__; keep verify_ear_jwt exported; put unverified ones on a clearly-named path or exclude from top-level re-exports.

discarded.reason: Escalated as a conflict between dropping EATClaimsSet entirely vs keeping it as-is; resolved by human decision to keep it, hardened (unions, jti routing, dropped from_cwt).
Escalated as a conflict between the one-file-each layout and a split-package layout; resolved by human decision to keep the one-file-each structure (eat_ear/cwt_jwt.py + eat_ear/cwt_jwt_utils.py).
